article.hook: Someone in the room just took the stage and refused to be ignored. Pluto in Leo is the long game of making your pride impossible to erase. It doesn’t ask permission; it demands space by sheer force of presence.
article.lived: For nearly two decades, this transit shapes an era where personal creativity and power swell to fill every corner of life. We see it in the way people don’t just want to be heard - they insist on being remembered, staking claim to their spotlight with bold projects, fierce declarations, or public gestures that refuse to shrink. It’s a slow burn reshaping what ‘being proud’ looks like, turning quiet confidence into something that pushes the room’s volume up, decade after decade.
article.turn: That same roar can turn into a chokehold on the room, where control tightens around vanity’s sharp edges. When pride becomes obsession, the need to be admired turns rigid, and power feels like a performance that can’t be dropped. The truth: demanding the spotlight means forcing others into shadows or losing yourself in the glare.
